title: Admin operational analytics dashboard
summary: Administrators with analytics access now get a desert-styled operations dashboard on /admin, with range-bounded account and workload KPIs, Chart.js trends, module warnings, and recent privileged events. Agents are also required to fill complete GitHub issue metadata.
changes: Replaced the three-count admin overview with range-selectable operational analytics, current-open workload, accessible data tables, and locally bundled Chart.js charts.
Cached anonymous aggregates briefly in the application cache, gated Overview on admin.analytics.view, and skipped Laravel maintenance down-file reads while the application is up.
Documented required GitHub issue sidebar metadata in AGENTS.md, an always-on Cursor rule, and a Task issue template.
affected_areas: Admin overview, module analytics providers, maintenance gateway, GitHub agent instructions, and Chart.js frontend bundle
version_rationale: A backward-compatible minor release adding the remaining public-release analytics dashboard without changing service-module workflows or authorization catalogues.
validation: Feature tests cover analytics authorization, 7/30/90 range bounds, fixture KPIs, disabled modules, cache expiry, privileged-event redaction, changelog validation, and the maintenance down-file skip.
known_limitations: Median closure is shown as not available until at least one item closes in the selected range.
This release does not bump nanoid and does not authorize production LDAP or deploy.
rollback: Revert this release record, VERSION, runtime manifest version, admin analytics aggregator and dashboard, Chart.js Vite entry, agent issue-metadata files, and the maintenance data() skip. No database rollback is needed.
provenance: Defined by the admin analytics dashboard work for MyAPES Account issues #15 and #60, completing roadmap #17.
